proof.superset: Every actual entry must be in the prior-ready/support, public-limit-fillable set. Cash/lot affordability is ignored; every opportunity may be skipped; failed-buy reset is ignored. Early exits may occur at the first public SELL-fillable session after E+1 irrespective of support/P conditions. Every real legal path is therefore in or dominated by this relaxed timing set.
proof.recurrence: D[e]=max(D[e+1],1+D[max(E+H+1,first_possible_public_sell(E)+1)]), eligible entries only; beyondN=0. Maximizes count over all possible choices, not a single greedy schedule.
proof.exit_dominance: For a fixed entry, any actual SELL is no earlier than the chosen public-fillable earliest exit. Replacing a real exit with that optimistic exit cannot delay any later entry. Thus using earliest legal SELL preserves an upper bound even if actual branch decisions differ.
proof.indices: Evaluation session1=2020-01-02; sourceindex0=2019-12-31 is excluded from warmup/support.
proof.no_profit_use: DP optimizes only opportunity count; witness is an optimistic retrospective feasibility certificate, not an executable strategy or a tested return.

limits: An upper below83 rules out the uniform H mechanism under current contracts. An upper at least83 proves neither actual count nor profitability.
Early-exit upper applies both R/P as a relaxation; it does not assert either rule actually exits that early.
H15/H18 are requested feasibility checks, not newly registered configurations.
